description: This file manages embedded project settings for a system, including loading, sanitizing, and merging configuration snapshots, and creating settings managers with specific policies.

methods.name: sanitizePiSettingsSnapshot
methods.description: Removes sensitive keys from a PiSettingsSnapshot to sanitize it.

methods.name: sanitizeProjectSettings
methods.description: Sanitizes project settings by removing plugin or workspace-local override keys.

methods.name: loadBundleSettingsFile
methods.description: Loads and sanitizes a bundle settings file from disk.

methods.name: loadEnabledBundlePiSettingsSnapshot
methods.description: Loads and merges enabled plugin bundle settings into a snapshot.

methods.name: resolveEmbeddedPiProjectSettingsPolicy
methods.description: Determines the project settings policy based on configuration.

methods.name: buildEmbeddedPiSettingsSnapshot
methods.description: Builds a combined settings snapshot based on global, plugin, and project settings with policy applied.

methods.name: createEmbeddedPiSettingsManager
methods.description: Creates a SettingsManager instance with embedded Pi project settings.

methods.name: createPreparedEmbeddedPiSettingsManager
methods.description: Creates and applies additional settings to a SettingsManager for embedded Pi projects.
